acceptance_criteria: On Linux a stop during cases run also stops a descendant that called setsid and an orphan of the tree. A grace kill after Chough own Git is reported on stderr. A failed git rev-parse HEAD other than no repository or no commit is reported on stderr. Each new test fails on main 91a1fdd and fledge lanes run verify passes on Linux.

answers.constraints: Bounded fix for issue 81 under FLOW-14 and LIFE-7; Linux only for the descendant walk and subreaper; other Unix keeps the group stop; no gate or record change; item 4 is investigated first
